summary: Dragon Age franchise entries added as supplemental sourced guide rows; Sami did not list these in the locked personal spine.

entries.title: Dragon Age: Origins
entries.definitive_edition: Dragon Age: Origins - Ultimate Edition on Windows

emulation.notes: Native Windows with stability fixes as needed.

primary.why: Origins released on Windows, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and Mac OS X. The Windows Ultimate Edition route has the highest capture/settings ceiling and bundles Awakening plus the DLC pack set.
primary.how_to_play: Use Dragon Age: Origins - Ultimate Edition on Windows. Apply known stability/fix notes before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster replacing the Windows Ultimate route is logged.

entries.title: Dragon Age Journeys

emulation.emulator: Flash preservation environment if legally archived

primary.why: Dragon Age Journeys is documented as a Flash-based browser tie-in to Origins. Only the first chapter was released, and the planned later chapters were cancelled, so the original browser release is the preservation target.
primary.how_to_play: No normal modern browser route is guaranteed because it required Flash. Preserve only verified archival builds/captures and do not claim the cancelled chapters exist.

entries.remaster_caveats: Flash-based and not normally playable in modern browsers.

entries.title: Dragon Age: Origins - Awakening
entries.definitive_edition: Dragon Age: Origins - Ultimate Edition on Windows

emulation.notes: Native Windows through Origins Ultimate Edition.

primary.version: Awakening through Dragon Age: Origins - Ultimate Edition
primary.why: Awakening is the Origins expansion campaign released on Windows, OS X, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360, later bundled in the Ultimate Edition. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Use Dragon Age: Origins - Ultimate Edition on Windows and launch the Awakening campaign from that install.

entries.remaster_caveats: Expansion entry; not a separate sequel.

entries.title: Dragon Age II

primary.why: Dragon Age II released on Windows, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and Mac OS X. The Windows route has the highest capture/settings ceiling, with DLC/story content routes available.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version with DLC installed. Apply community fixes as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster replacing the Windows route is logged.

entries.title: Dragon Age Legends

primary.why: Dragon Age Legends was a Flash social game for Facebook, Google+, and web browser. Its servers were shut down in 2012, but a free standalone Adobe AIR version released after shutdown, making that the best preservation route for the core game.
primary.how_to_play: Use the post-shutdown standalone build only if it can be legally and safely obtained. Treat social-platform features as retired.

secondary.exclusive_content: Dragon Age Legends: Remix 01, a modified hack-and-slash browser version.
secondary.what_to_play: Play/document the Remix 01 variant separately if a verified archival route exists.
secondary.why: Remix 01 is a modified version with different hack-and-slash gameplay.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original Facebook/Google+ service features are gone.

entries.title: Heroes of Dragon Age
entries.definitive_edition: No current playable definitive edition after service retirement

emulation.notes: Live-service retirement is the blocker, not emulation.

primary.version: Final mobile service build before shutdown
primary.why: Heroes of Dragon Age is an iOS/Android mobile spin-off. Its mobile live-service was retired, so iOS is only an archival target, not a normal current play route.
primary.how_to_play: No normal official play route is available after retirement. Preserve only existing captures, metadata, and legally retained local materials.

entries.remaster_caveats: Retired mobile service; do not present as normally playable.

entries.title: Dragon Age: The Last Court
entries.definitive_edition: Original Dragon Age Keep browser release

emulation.notes: Browser service shutdown is the blocker.

primary.version: Original Dragon Age Keep browser release
primary.why: The Last Court was a free browser/resource-management Dragon Age game from Failbetter Games, previously accessible through Dragon Age Keep and later taken offline. The original web browser release is the only sourced official route.
primary.how_to_play: No normal official play route is available after shutdown. Preserve screenshots/text/captures and treat fan rebuilds as non-official comparison material.

entries.remaster_caveats: Official route is offline; fan rebuilds are not the official primary route.

entries.title: Dragon Age: Inquisition
entries.definitive_edition: Game of the Year Edition on Windows

primary.why: Inquisition released on Windows, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, Xbox 360, and Xbox One. The Game of the Year Edition bundles the base game and all post-launch content, and later DLC support moved beyond PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. Windows GOTY is therefore both the fidelity and complete-content route.
primary.how_to_play: Use Dragon Age: Inquisition Game of the Year Edition on Windows with all story DLC installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use GOTY/complete DLC route; avoid PS3/Xbox 360 for a complete playthrough.

entries.title: Dragon Age: The Veilguard

primary.why: The Veilguard released on PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S. Windows is the highest-fidelity capture route with a well-supported PC version.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version with patches installed. Confirm settings and capture stability before recording.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster replacing the Windows route is logged.
